name: אינטגרציה בחלקים פעמיים – x²·sin או x²·cos (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Integrate {{CT:0}} with respect to {{CT:1}}.

\(\int {{CT:2}}\,d{{CT:3}} = \) [[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Integrate by parts twice: each time the power of the variable drops by one.
Step 1 — First integration by parts
For this question we will use integration by parts. Remembering that the formula is:

\[ \int u\,\frac{dv}{dt}\,dt = uv - \int v\,\frac{du}{dt}\,dt. \]

Now we want to find \(\int {{CT:2}}\,d{{CT:3}}\). So, we let

\[ u = {{CT:3}}^2\quad\Rightarrow\quad \frac{du}{d{{CT:3}}} = 2{{CT:3}}, \]

and

\[ \frac{dv}{dt} = {{CT:4}}\quad\Rightarrow\quad v = {{CT:5}}. \]

We can now substitute these into the formula to find that:

\[ \int {{CT:2}}\,d{{CT:3}} = {{CT:6}} - \int {{CT:7}}\,d{{CT:3}}. \]

Step 2 — Second integration by parts
We now have to perform an integration by parts again on what we have found. This time:

\[ u = 2{{CT:3}}\quad\Rightarrow\quad \frac{du}{d{{CT:3}}}=2, \]

and

\[ \frac{dv}{dt} = {{CT:5}}\quad\Rightarrow\quad v={{CT:8}}. \]

Step 3 — Putting it together
So we get:

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:2}}\,d{{CT:3}} &= {{CT:6}} - \int {{CT:7}}\,d{{CT:3}}, \\ &= {{CT:6}} - \left({{CT:9}} - 2\int {{CT:8}}\,d{{CT:3}}\right). \end{aligned} \]

Which means:

\[ \begin{aligned} \int {{CT:2}}\,d{{CT:3}} &= {{CT:6}} - \left({{CT:9}} - ({{CT:10}})\right), \\ &= {{CT:11}} + constant . \end{aligned} \]

nodes.sans: if p=sin(v) and ans1=(2-v^2)*cos(v)-2*v*sin(v) then true else false

on_true.feedback: It seems you have used the wrong formula for integration parts. You have used \[\int u\frac{dv}{dt}\,dt = uv + \int v\frac{du}{dt}\,dt,\] instead of \[\int u\frac{dv}{dt}\,dt = uv - \int v\frac{du}{dt}\,dt\]
